name: JPT partition — JPT2 against its decoy paralog JPT1
description: The JPT half of the project, run with its sharp decoy in the set. JPT1 (HN1) carries PF17054 exactly as JPT2 does, is the same size class, and is not a NAADP binder — no domain signature distinguishes the binder from its paralog, which is the whole problem this project is built around. SYMBOL TRAP, verified 2026-08-18: gene_exact:HN1L returns both Q9H910 (190 aa, the real JPT2) and CRAMP1 (Q96RY5, 1,269 aa) on a synonym, so a longest-first pick selects the wrong protein. Screen by length and Pfam, never by rank.
